reason: The hypothesis directly applies FSP as a repair treatment to nickel-based superalloys (Hastelloy-X, Inconel 713C) to eliminate hot cracking, which is explicitly proposed as future work or demonstrated in aluminum alloys (P2, P4, P5, P9) and mentioned for IN738 (P2). The mechanism, intervention, and predicted outcome are taken almost verbatim from these passages, and the problem of hot cracking in Inconel 713C is well-documented (P3, P6, P17). The only new element is the specific falsification test design, but the core idea restates existing proposals and results.
